content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:

Step 2. Gather company legal entity documentation (2 hours)
Step 3. Execute the first live payroll run (1 hour)
Step 4. Input employee bank account details for direct deposit (3 hours)
Step 5. Set up workers compensation insurance codes (2 hours)
Step 6. Establish department cost centers (1 hour)
Step 7. Create the administrative owner account (30 minutes)
Step 8. Verify employer identification numbers (15 minutes)
Step 9. Validate state unemployment insurance rates (20 minutes)
Step 10. Define the annual payroll calendar (1 hour)
Step 11. Upload historical year-to-date earnings (5 hours)

Step 13. Map earnings codes to the payroll grid (2 hours)
Step 14. Input company bank funding instructions (1 hour)
Step 15. Distribute first pay stubs to employees (15 minutes)

Step 20. Select the ADP service package (45 minutes)

Step 22. Assign employees to specific departments (3 hours)

Step 44. Link the business bank account for tax debits (2 days)

Step 51. Enter employee tax withholding (W-4) info (2 hours)

Step 54. Configure expense reimbursement categories (1 hour)
Step 55. Set up manager email notifications (10 minutes)
Step 56. Map time-clock hardware to the software (3 hours)
Step 57. Set up benefit plan types (4 hours)
Step 58. Create user security profiles (2 hours)
Step 59. Set up workers compensation policy numbers (1 hour)
Step 60. Review quarterly tax filing settings (1 hour)
Step 61. Define pay groups for different regions (2 hours)
Step 62. Reconcile opening tax balances (4 hours)
Step 63. Conduct employee training on the new system (4 hours)
Step 64. Review the initial implementation checklist (2 hours)
Step 65. Verify company contact information (15 minutes)
Step 66. Define pay period start and end dates (1 hour)
Step 67. Confirm the payroll funding method (30 minutes)
Step 68. Assign work schedules to employees (4 hours)
Step 69. Set up voluntary life insurance deductions (2 hours)
Step 70. Validate year-to-date tax totals (2 hours)
